notes.title: Bug Squashing 0.9.1v
notes.content:
⌨️Typing Tales gets fixes ⌨️


Thank you everyone for your patience!


What's New? 🤔

🎊 Features 🪄:
Added language support 👉 french!

Added language support 👉 spanish!

Added language support 👉 italian!

Added language support 👉 portuguese!

Added language support 👉 german!


🌜QoL🌛:
Adjusted loot screen type label so it's easier to see

Space is now ignored as a default in input


🪳Bug Fixes🦟:
Music didn't work correctly on game start

Fixed several localization issues

Removed offensive words

Removed most names

Removed a crash on startup when language didn't exist in game

Fixed crash when locale wasn't setup correctly and an ability was used

Fixed an issue where abilities weren't being triggered correctly in other languages

removed exploit when looting

enemy ability timers now correctly pause when looting

removed 100% loot and pickup chance

removed buggy transition out of loot screen

removed words that conflict with auto submit

fixed abilities not working in another language


💪 Want to Help? 🦵


There's a ton of ways you can help make Typing Tales better! Above all I'm thankful for your time and that you've read this post. Even if you only play the game, you're already supporting me greatly; so thank you! 🙇


Join the Community!


You can join the community on discord here 👉 

https://discord.gg/FBdGDag9xd





There you can give feedback on...



Bugs! 🦟

Missing features you'd like to see! 🔨

Localization issues! 🌐

And anything else you can think of! 😀

Check out the roadmap here 👉 

https://open.codecks.io/typing_titans

  If anything is missing from the next release or future releases tell me about it!



💓🔥  Thank you for your continued love and support! 🔥💓


👇 Connect 👇

notes.title: Second Playtest is live - With your feeback!
notes.content:
⌨️Typing Tales is ready for your Fingers!⌨️
 

A lot of things changed thanks to your feedback!


What's New? 🤔🤔🤔

🎊 Features 🪄: 
Added a tutorial! 👉 auto plays first time player enters a map and starts a game

Added modifiers! 👉 endless: game goes on forever, frail: you only have one health, perfect: a single wrong keystroke ends the run

Added difficulty selection! 👉 from 50 to 500. Influences enemy word length, spawns, speed, ability usage, etc.

Added a ton of pickups! 👇

pickup: damage 👉 doubles damage dealt from typing

pickup: experience 👉 doubles all experience and gathers automatically on first pickup

pickup: health 👉 heals you by 3

pickup: letter 👉 reduces all enemy words by one letter. If the enemy has a 4 letter word, it dies

pickup: loot 👉 open it for a bunch of upgrades!

pickup: movement 👉 quadruples your movement distance!

pickup: push 👉 pushes all enemy back a huge amount

pickup: refresh 👉 refreshes all your ability cooldowns

pickup: shock 👉 when you damage an enemy by typing, damage another random one in range

Added a special event per map! 👉 rewards will be available in a future patch

Added support for Russian Language

Added credits scene, now you can see everyone who's helped on the game!

Added minimap in-game! 👉 see where you are relative to pickups


🔨 Balancing 🔧: 
Changed all ability cooldown values

Made characters starting ability three times as strong

Enemy spawns are now more dynamic to ensure a stable level of difficulty

Enemy words also increase in length as the game goes on

Enemy movement scales with difficulty and time

Enemy word length influences amount of xp dropped

Enemy abilities scale with difficulty and time as well

Map has been completely reworked so the player can actually traverse through it more easily

Improved player movement distance


🌜QoL🌛:
Language can now be chosen by typing it from main menu!

Enter advances main menu automatically; can be done all the way into the game!

Added pickup disappearing animation

Added pickup duration display

Added pickup active VFX

Ability duration and stats are now reflected correctly in-game and in Main Menu

Added animation for player movement

Improved SFX for different events in-game

Movement directions now auto-submit!

Typing "menu" or "restart" from the pause menu in-game automatically executes those actions

Pausing the game shows what each value on the left-hand UI means

Added pickups on the minimap display

Added loot screen and three different rarities; I hope you enjoy the VFX!


🪳Bug Fixes🦟:
Language button(s) now works correctly in Main Menu

Pickups correctly stop when game is paused

Fixed incorrect highlighting of words

Select Screen text overflowing is no more!

Cyclic dependency which caused game crash has been slain! 

Fixed issue with game not pausing correctly

Fixed enemy abilities still occurring when game is paused

And many others I forgot to document! 🙈


💪 Want to Help? 🦵


There's a ton of ways you can help make Typing Tales better! Above all I'm thankful for your time and that you've read this post. Even if you only play the game, you're already supporting me greatly; so thank you! 🙇


Join the Community!


You can join the community on discord here 👉 https://discord.gg/FBdGDag9xd



There you can give feedback on...



Bugs! 🦟

Missing features you'd like to see! 🔨

Game feel or balance being off! 🔧

Localization issues! 🌐

And anything else you can think of! 😀




Do you want Typing Tales in your language?


Please let me know in Discord or here in the comments. I'm just a guy and I only speak english; so other languages are a huge effort.

I'm happy to do it though!



🏃‍➡️ What's Next? 🏃


Check out the roadmap here 👉 https://open.codecks.io/typing_titans

If anything is missing from the next release or future releases tell me about it!



💓🔥  Thank you for your continued love and support! 🔥💓

notes.title: Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
⌨️Typing Tales playtest is now live on steam!⌨️

The tale begins! I'm excited to share with everyone that the Typing Tales Playtest is now live! 

How To Access


 Hit the "Request Access" button on the steam page
 You can now download from your steam library and play!
 Don't forget to give your feedback in the official discord


It's that easy!

What is the Playtest


 A pre-alpha look at the game
 You'll get to try out the main gameplay and give feedback on it through the Discord Server
 An opportunity to shape the game's development through the community
 Sneak peeks at future updates
 Minimal content as the focus right now is on gameplay
 Bugs 🙈
    



Let me know in the comments if you have any questions!

Can't wait to hear your thoughts, and don't forget,

Join the Discord! 👇
